note: Evil Mode slice 2 (slice 6: locals also take Lean, Take and Expose; three have a secret that is true, two are hard to frighten): one Kanto district (design Part 6, Part 7, Part 26a). Twenty steps, eight locals drawn from the written deck of twenty, four methods (Scout, Persuade, Pay, Outplay). Starting values, not playtested. Slice 9: Kanto's eight stages (n 0 the Arrival at Pewter, 1 to 6 the districts, 7 the Reckoning at Viridian), each with its own streets and places; Celadon and Saffron are towers of floors (Kanto's own holding, Part 26a section 2.3); Kanto's eight locals (Part 26a section 2.5) live in their own districts.

districts.grievance: The museum's short of guards and the quarry's short of work. Nobody here's heard of you.
Water rates tripled last year.
The docks pay by the tide, and the harbourmaster keeps a ledger with everyone in it.

safehouse: A cabin on a laid-up trawler

districts.grievance: The store sets every price in the city, and the Game Corner sets the rest.

safehouse: A room at the Celadon Mansion

floors.name: Ground floor: the perfume counter
floors.says: We pay the store by the square foot. You'd have to pay us by the bottle.

floors.name: Second floor: trainers' goods
floors.says: Every Ball in the city's sold on this floor or it's a fake.

floors.name: Third floor: TMs
floors.says: A lease, a lawyer and a locked case. You'll want the lawyer.

floors.name: Fourth floor: gifts
floors.says: I buy what sells at the start of the season. I've stopped asking who buys it.

floors.name: The rooftop: vending and the view
floors.says: You can see the whole city from here. Including the Game Corner's back door.

districts.grievance: The Safari Zone's losing visitors, and the warden's losing his teeth.
Silph built half the city and owns the other half. Eleven floors, and four people signed in this week never signed out.

floors.name: Silph 1F: Reception
floors.says: Sign here. And here. Nobody reads it.

floors.name: Silph 2F: Facilities
floors.says: We've keys to every floor but the seventh.

floors.name: Silph 3F: Sales
floors.says: Targets are up. They're always up.

floors.name: Silph 4F: Accounts
floors.says: We pay eleven floors and we're paid last.

floors.name: Silph 5F: The canteen
floors.says: Soup's on. The engineers eat at their desks.

floors.name: Silph 6F: Testing
floors.says: We throw things at walls for a living. It's fine.

floors.name: Silph 7F: Research
floors.says: There's a prototype on seven. We don't talk about seven.

floors.name: Silph 8F: Legal
floors.says: Everything in this building is owned, including the air conditioning.

floors.name: Silph 9F: The archive
floors.says: Forty years of paper. Some of it's interesting.

floors.name: Silph 10F: The boardroom
floors.says: The board meets on Thursdays. It decides on Wednesdays.

floors.name: Silph 11F: The president's office
floors.says: He'll see you. He sees everybody, eventually.

districts.grievance: An island with a burned mansion, a lab that won't talk about what it made, and a ferry Blaine's never once taken.
The eighth Gym's the neighbour's. The Hero wins their last Badge here, the day before they come for you.
A tower with a swaying pillar and monks who'll talk to anyone. Nobody here's heard of you, and the monks will ask.
A well, a charcoal kiln, Kurt's workshop. Somebody's been cutting the Slowpoke's tails.

safehouse: A room at Kurt's (if he'll have you)

districts.grievance: The region's one real city: a department store, a radio tower, an underground. The underground's landlord sets every rent.

safehouse: A flat above the flower shop

districts.grievance: Two towers, one burned. The dance theatre's roof leaks, and the town remembers everything.
Across the water: a pharmacy, a Gym under a waterfall. Everything comes by boat, and the sea's rough.
A lighthouse with a sick Ampharos at the top. A port. The medicine's in Cianwood: the district's whole Bend is a boat.
A souvenir shop with a stair under it. The lake to the north is red, and nobody says why.
A Leader who won't hand over the Badge till she's sure. She's that way with the team too.

safehouse: A room over the Move Deleter's

districts.grievance: A school city: the Devon works, a tunnel half-dug and stopped because the noise frightened the Whismur.

safehouse: A room at the Cutter's house

districts.grievance: An island with a fad. Whatever the island's saying this week is worth a mood to say back.
A crossroads: a Game Corner, a bike shop, an old man who built a power plant and forgot to turn it off.

safehouse: A flat above the bike shop

districts.grievance: A hot-spring town under a volcano. Somebody's drilling the mountain.
The Leader's the Hero's father. His Bend is time with his child, and he hasn't any.
A town in the trees. A weather institute up the road, short of money since the last storm took the roof.
Twins, both twelve: both, or neither. A space centre. The sea all round.
A crater, reached under water. If the weather's wrong, the Hero walks to the base under rain and sun at once.

safehouse: A house cut into the crater wall

kinds.name: An opportunity
places: The bicycle shop nobody can afford
kinds.why: Schemes come in a later build.

kinds.name: The Town
kinds.why: The Town follows its street: hold most of the four nearest locals.

kinds.name: The Gym
kinds.why: Only scouted from Dispatch (a talk with the caretaker). The five ways are in person: the Gym page (Y).

kinds.name: A floor
kinds.why: Floors are held from the bottom: work the one below first, or warm its tenant.

kinds.name: A kept place
kinds.why: Held by upkeep (Persuade here is sweeping it, mending the rail, leaving the rice). It pays nothing: every holding in the district is a mood warmer while it's kept. Nothing can be taken from it. Left with nobody, it lapses.

kinds.name: A water route
kinds.why: Held by running the boats (Outplay here is a boat a day, there and back). It pays small fares. Left with nobody, it lapses, unless a Tide kit runs it alone. An Ember team can't hold one: the Slugma won't get in the boat.

persuade.won: "They asked us in for tea, Boss. We said yes."
"Shook on it. Didn't even have to raise my voice."
persuade.lost: "Not today, they said. But they said it nicely."
pay.won: "Signed. They asked who we are. I didn't know what to say."
pay.lost: "Too low, Boss. They didn't say so. They didn't have to."
outplay.won: "Fair fight. They shook our hands after."
"Crowd came out to watch. We won it clean."
outplay.lost: "We lost. They bought us a drink anyway."
"Rematch tomorrow, they said. We need a lie-down first."
scout.won: "Had a look round. Wrote it all down."
lean.won: "We stood about. They got the idea."
lean.lost: "Told us to get out. So we got out."
"They weren't frightened, Boss. They were angry."
take.won: "Got it. There was a drawing on the fridge. I didn't look at it."
take.lost: "A light came on upstairs. We ran."
"Dog. Big one. Name on the bowl."
expose.won: "It's on the front page. They're reading it on the bridge."
"Every word true. That's what did it."
expose.lost: "Nobody'd print it. The editor drinks with him."

ends.held: The district's yours. Eleven holdings and counting.
ends.taken: The seventh day's over and it isn't yours. The Hero will walk through it.

locals.want: Her son home from the city.
locals.says: Nobody gives a ferry woman a new engine for nothing.

locals.trade: Mill hand; a Growlithe older than most Grunts
locals.want: A rematch with the foreman.
locals.says: Singles. No switching. I've work at six.

locals.trade: Fisherman; eleventh boat on the dock
locals.want: A fair price for the catch.
locals.says: Everyone's got a hand out. Yours is cleaner. That's all I'll say.

locals.want: A doctor within a day's walk; her mother's ill.
locals.says: If you're buying, buy. If you're not, the door's behind you.

locals.trade: Owns the cannery, the dock scales and two streets
locals.want: Nothing. He's got what he needs.
locals.says: I've seen four teams come through here. I've outlasted the paint on all of them.
locals.secret: The dock scales read light. Every boat on the dock's been paid short for six years.

locals.want: The bridge mended.
locals.says: I've a file on that bridge this thick. Nobody's ever asked to read it.

locals.trade: Retired Ace; a Dragonair on the porch
locals.want: Someone to play cards with.
locals.says: I'm not teaching you anything. Sit down. Can you play cribbage?
locals.noPrice: He's got a pension and a Dragonair.

locals.want: The noise to stop.
locals.says: I hear everything. I repeat about half. Which half depends.

locals.trade: The only doctor in three districts
locals.want: A clinic that isn't his front room.
locals.says: I'll treat anyone. I'd like that understood before you tell me who you are.

locals.want: A pupil who'll go further than here.
locals.says: They've already drawn your uniform. Come and see. Decide for yourself if it's flattering.

locals.want: His name cleared.
locals.says: I know how you get in. I know because it's how I'd get in.

locals.trade: Keeps the shrine on the hill
locals.want: The lights back on along the path.
locals.says: I bless anyone who asks. It's not a judgement. It's a job.

locals.trade: Breeder; six Eevee and an opinion on each
locals.want: The Alpha off her top field.
locals.says: I sell one a season. To people I like. You've a way to go.

locals.want: The inspector to pass him.
locals.says: Everyone here owes me something. I find it restful.
locals.secret: The bank's calling in loans on the waterfront so it can sell the land to the water board.

locals.trade: Runs her dad's stall since he took ill
locals.want: A stall at the proper market.
locals.says: If this is about protection, I can't afford to be protected.

locals.want: Just to be left alone.
locals.says: (He doesn't say anything. He goes on loading.)

locals.trade: Landlord of four cottages; charges too little
locals.want: Somebody to take over when she can't.
locals.says: I keep meaning to put the rents up. Then I meet the tenants.

locals.want: A story that isn't the fête.
locals.says: I'll print what's true. If you want something else printed, you'll need a different paper.

locals.who: Little Ines Amadi, 11, and her Wooper
locals.trade: No trade. She's always at this step
locals.want: To know who you are.
locals.says: Are you the baddies? Miss says you might be. I said I'd ask.

locals.want: The mill kept open.
locals.says: I'll hear you out. I've heard them all out. Then I've gone back to work.
locals.secret: He's been told the mill shuts in the spring. He hasn't told the hands.

locals.want: Somebody to look at the fossils with
locals.fear: Being pensioned off before the Aerodactyl's mounted
locals.says: Nobody steals from a museum in Pewter. It's all rocks. ...You're not here about the rocks.

locals.want: To sell one bicycle. Just one
locals.says: Nine years. Not one. People come in to look at the price and laugh.

locals.trade: Purser on the liner, retired ashore
locals.want: His sea legs back
locals.fear: The harbourmaster's ledger, which he's in
locals.says: I've seen every sort come up a gangway. You're the sort that pays for the cabin and uses the hold.
locals.secret: He signed two cabins off as sailed that never left the quay.

locals.want: Her own shop, small, with a bell
locals.says: Third floor's TMs. Fourth's gifts. You want the fifth, and you want it after closing. I can smell it on you.

locals.trade: Keeps the house in Lavender; takes in what's left behind
locals.want: Nothing for himself
locals.says: You've a Growlithe with you that isn't yours. No, don't explain. Is it eating?
locals.noPrice: He takes nothing, and he sells nothing.
locals.lockWhy: Mr. Fuji can't be Leaned on or Taken from. Every Kind refuses, and so does Otis, who isn't.

locals.trade: The gate at the Safari Zone
locals.want: The warden's teeth found, so the man'll stop mumbling at him
locals.says: Five hundred steps and you're out. That's the rule. I don't make exceptions. I've made four.

locals.want: To go home at five
locals.says: I've signed in eleven floors of people this week. Four of them never signed out.
locals.secret: She signed four people in who never signed out, and she kept the sheets.

locals.want: To be asked about the fossils instead
locals.fear: Being asked about the other thing
locals.says: We made something here once. I'd rather you asked about the fossils.

locals.want: The pillar to go on swaying
locals.says: It sways so the tower needn't. You look like someone who's never been allowed to sway.
locals.noPrice: He takes nothing for the tower, and he sells nothing.
locals.lockWhy: Elder Li can't be Leaned on or Taken from. He's ninety, and every monk in Violet is watching.

locals.trade: Makes Balls from Apricorns, by hand
locals.want: His granddaughter safe; the Slowpoke left alone
locals.says: I'll not make a Ball for anything that's going in a cage. I can tell. Don't ask me how.

locals.want: Her sister back from Kanto
locals.says: Everyone who comes in here's sorry for something. What're you sorry for? I'll tell you which flower.

locals.want: A night's sleep
locals.fear: A man in black who's been asking about the transmitter room
locals.says: I can tell you who's on air. I can't tell you who's in the building. They've started not signing in.
locals.secret: He's been letting someone into the transmitter room after midnight, because he was paid to look the other way once and can't stop.

locals.want: Pupils
locals.says: We've danced for four Leaders and a thing in a tower. We'll dance for a villain. Sit at the back.

locals.want: Somebody to row the medicine over; he's too old and the sea's rough
locals.says: I've the one thing that girl's Ampharos needs and no way to get it across. If you've a boat, you've a friend.

locals.want: Jasmine to come down and eat something
locals.says: She's not left the top floor in nine days. I take the stairs up with a tray and down with a tray.

locals.trade: The till at the Mahogany souvenir shop
locals.want: Not to know what's under her floor
locals.says: It's a shop. I sell RageCandyBars. I'd thank you not to lean on that poster.
locals.secret: There's a stair behind the poster, and she's heard the Grunts on it every night since spring.

locals.trade: Retired sailor; one boat; a Wingull called Peeko
locals.want: Peeko home
locals.says: Peeko! ...Sorry. I thought you were Peeko. You've come about the boat. Everyone does, eventually.

locals.want: To know what the fad is before her daughter does
locals.says: Have you heard? 'Stylish cookies.' That's what everyone's saying. Don't ask me. It was 'great winter' last week.

locals.trade: Built New Mauville; can't remember where he left the key
locals.want: The generator switched off
locals.says: It's still running. Down there. I can feel it in my teeth. Wahaha! ...It isn't funny. Somebody ought to go.

locals.want: Flannery to stop apologising
locals.says: The spring's a degree hotter than last year. I've sat in it every morning for sixty years. I know a degree.

locals.trade: A boy from Petalburg, off to Verdanturf for his lungs
locals.want: To be strong enough
locals.says: Are you a Trainer? Could you— no. Sorry. You look busy.
locals.noPrice: He's a child. He can be helped. He can't be used.

locals.trade: Reads the instruments at the Institute
locals.want: To be believed
locals.says: It's going to rain for a hundred years or not at all, and I can tell you which by Thursday, and nobody's asked.

locals.want: A quiet season
locals.says: The trench was a metre shallower last month. Trenches don't do that.

locals.who: The lady at the Sootopolis ferry
locals.trade: Rows people across the crater, four at a time
locals.want: To retire. She's got a figure in mind
locals.says: Everyone who comes here's come to save it or sink it. Which are you? It's the same fare.
